text:
What to do:

  1. Pick a topic you are interested in (big or small). See below for some ideas
    • Dinosaurs
    • Your favourite film or TV show
    • Your garden
    • An animal you like
    • Someone famous or from history
    • Anything you like!
  2. Write down five facts about it.
  3. Think about how to share those facts in an interesting way.
  4. Practise your presentation.
  5. Show your presentation to someone in your house!

How could I share my facts?

  • You could talk about them. Remember to say some words to introduce the topic before you say your facts.
  • You could make a poster about your facts and then talk about your poster.
  • You could use a computer to make a presentation and then talk about it.
  • You could show pictures in a book to help you talk about your facts.
